SET @prov_c := '%s';
SET	@id := '%s';
SET @cat_id := '%s';
SET	@send :=  IF((SELECT active FROM sys_report WHERE cat_id = @cat_id and id = @id )=1,0,2);
SET	@b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET @start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS s_copd60(
  id varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  hospcode varchar(5) NOT NULL,
  areacode varchar(8) NOT NULL,
  flag_sent varchar(1) NOT NULL,
  date_com varchar(14) NOT NULL,
  b_year varchar(4) NOT NULL,
	target int(10) DEFAULT 0,
	result int(10) DEFAULT 0,
	target1 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
	result1 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
PRIMARY KEY (id,hospcode,areacode,b_year),
	KEY (hospcode),
	KEY (areacode),
	KEY (b_year)
) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

DELETE FROM s_copd60 WHERE id=@id AND b_year=(@b_year+543);

INSERT IGNORE INTO s_copd60(id,hospcode,areacode,flag_sent,date_com,b_year,target,result)
(
SELECT @id,h.hoscode
,concat(h.provcode,SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.distcode),-2),SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.subdistcode),-2),SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.mu),-2)) as areacode
,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i%s') as d_com,@b_year+543 as b_year
,COUNT(DISTINCT p.cid) c_target
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(SUBSTR(t.diagcode,1,4) IN('J440','J441') 
		AND h1.hostype in(5,6,7,11,12,15) AND h1.hdc_regist IN(1)
		,CONCAT(t.cid,'-',t.seq,'-',t.date_serv),NULL)) c_result
FROM tmp_copd  t 
INNER JOIN t_person_cid p ON t.cid=p.cid
INNER JOIN chospital h ON p.check_hosp=h.hoscode
INNER JOIN chospital h1 ON t.hospcode=h1.hoscode
WHERE p.check_typearea IN(1,3) AND p.nation in(99) AND p.discharge IN(9) AND t.diagtype IN(1) 
AND p.age_y >=40 	AND t.date_serv BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d
GROUP BY h.hoscode
);

INSERT IGNORE INTO s_copd60(id,hospcode,areacode,flag_sent,date_com,b_year,target1,result1)
(
SELECT @id,h.hoscode
,concat(h.provcode,SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.distcode),-2),SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.subdistcode),-2),SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.mu),-2)) as areacode
,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i%s') as d_com,@b_year+543 as b_year
,COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(t.hospcode,'-',t.pid)) w_target
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(SUBSTR(t.diagcode,1,4) IN('J440','J441') ,CONCAT(t.hospcode,'-',t.pid,'-',t.seq,'-',t.date_serv),NULL)) w_result
FROM tmp_copd  t INNER JOIN chospital h ON t.hospcode=h.hoscode 
INNER JOIN t_person_db p ON t.hospcode=p.hospcode AND t.pid=p.pid
WHERE TIMESTAMPDIFF(year,p.birth,t.date_serv) >=40 AND p.nation in(99) AND p.discharge IN(9) AND t.diagtype IN(1)
	AND t.date_serv BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d AND h.hostype in(5,6,7,11,12,15) AND h.hdc_regist IN(1)
GROUP BY h.hoscode
);

UPDATE s_copd60  s INNER JOIN (
SELECT h.hoscode,@b_year+543 as b_year
,COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(t.hospcode,'-',t.pid)) w_target
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(SUBSTR(t.diagcode,1,4) IN('J440','J441') ,CONCAT(t.hospcode,'-',t.pid,'-',t.seq,'-',t.date_serv),NULL)) w_result
FROM tmp_copd  t INNER JOIN chospital h ON t.hospcode=h.hoscode 
INNER JOIN t_person_db p ON t.hospcode=p.hospcode AND t.pid=p.pid
WHERE TIMESTAMPDIFF(year,p.birth,t.date_serv) >=40 AND p.nation in(99) AND p.discharge IN(9) AND t.diagtype IN(1)
	AND t.date_serv BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d AND h.hostype in(5,6,7,11,12,15) AND h.hdc_regist IN(1)
GROUP BY h.hoscode
) t ON  s.hospcode=t.hoscode AND s.b_year=t.b_year 
SET s.target1=t.w_target ,s.result1=t.w_result;

SET @prov_c := ( SELECT provincecode FROM sys_config LIMIT 1 );
SET @b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET @start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930');

DROP TEMPORARY TABLE IF EXISTS tmp_copd_g;
CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tmp_copd_g( 
mix_seq varchar(255) ,mix_date_serv varchar(255) ,mix_diagcode varchar(255),mix_diagtype varchar(255) ,ncount int(10) ,
PRIMARY KEY (hospcode,pid),KEY (hospcode,pid),KEY (cid) ) ENGINE=MyISAM IGNORE AS
SELECT t.*,null as mix_seq,null as mix_date_serv,null as mix_diagcode,null as mix_diagtype,0 as ncount  
FROM tmp_copd t  INNER JOIN chospital h ON t.hospcode=h.hoscode
INNER JOIN t_person_db p ON t.hospcode=p.hospcode AND t.pid=p.pid
WHERE TIMESTAMPDIFF(year,p.birth,t.date_serv) >=40 AND  SUBSTR(diagcode,1,4) IN('J440','J441')
		AND DATE_SERV BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d  AND h.hostype in(5,6,7,11,12,15) AND h.hdc_regist IN(1)
		AND p.discharge  in(9) AND p.nation  in(99)
 ORDER BY t.hospcode,t.pid,t.DATE_SERV ;

UPDATE tmp_copd_g g INNER JOIN (
SELECT t.hospcode,t.pid
,GROUP_CONCAT(seq ORDER BY date_serv) as mix_seq
,GROUP_CONCAT(date_serv ORDER BY date_serv) as mix_date_serv
,GROUP_CONCAT(diagcode ORDER BY date_serv) as mix_diagcode
,GROUP_CONCAT(diagtype ORDER BY date_serv) as mix_diagtype
,COUNT(DISTINCT concat(t.hospcode,'-',t.pid,'-',t.seq,'-',t.date_serv)) ncount
FROM tmp_copd  t INNER JOIN chospital h ON t.hospcode=h.hoscode 
INNER JOIN t_person_db p ON t.hospcode=p.hospcode AND t.pid=p.pid
WHERE TIMESTAMPDIFF(year,p.birth,t.date_serv) >=40 AND SUBSTR(diagcode,1,4) IN('J440','J441')
	AND t.date_serv BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d AND h.hostype in(5,6,7,11,12,15) AND h.hdc_regist IN(1) 
GROUP BY t.hospcode,t.pid 
) s ON g.hospcode=s.hospcode AND g.pid=s.pid
SET g.mix_seq=s.mix_seq,g.mix_date_serv=s.mix_date_serv 
,g.mix_diagcode=s.mix_diagcode,g.mix_diagtype=s.mix_diagtype ,g.ncount=s.ncount;

INSERT IGNORE INTO tmp_copd_g (SELECT t.*,null,null,null,null,0
	FROM tmp_copd t  INNER JOIN chospital h ON t.hospcode=h.hoscode
	INNER JOIN t_person_db p ON t.hospcode=p.hospcode AND t.pid=p.pid
	WHERE TIMESTAMPDIFF(year,p.birth,t.date_serv) >=40	AND h.hostype in(5,6,7,11,12,15) AND h.hdc_regist IN(1)
		AND DATE_SERV BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d 
	AND p.discharge  in(9) AND p.nation  in(99)
	ORDER BY t.hospcode,t.pid,t.DATE_SERV);

DROP TEMPORARY TABLE IF EXISTS tx;
CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tx (PRIMARY KEY (HOSPCODE,PID)) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8 IGNORE  AS
SELECT p.hospcode,p.pid,p.CID,p.NAME,p.LNAME,p.BIRTH,p.SEX,p.NATION,p.check_typearea
,p.addr,p.check_vhid,p.DISCHARGE
,seq,date_serv,diagcode,diagtype
,mix_seq,mix_date_serv,mix_diagcode,mix_diagtype,ncount
FROM tmp_copd_g  t INNER JOIN chospital h ON t.hospcode=h.hoscode 
INNER JOIN t_person_db p ON t.hospcode=p.hospcode AND t.pid=p.pid
WHERE TIMESTAMPDIFF(year,p.birth,t.date_serv) >=40 
	AND t.date_serv BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d AND h.hostype in(5,6,7,11,12,15) AND h.hdc_regist IN(1) 
ORDER BY  t.hospcode,t.pid,t.date_serv;
 
SELECT
h.hoscode,h.hosname,d.pid,d.CID,d.NAME,d.LNAME,d.BIRTH,d.SEX,d.NATION,d.check_typearea,d.addr,d.check_vhid,d.DISCHARGE
,d.seq,d.date_serv,d.diagcode,d.diagtype,d.mix_seq,d.mix_date_serv,d.mix_diagcode,d.mix_diagtype,d.ncount
FROM tx d 
INNER JOIN chospital h ON d.hospcode = h.hoscode
WHERE 1=1 {where}

zone.label: เขตสุขภาพ
zone.query: SELECT h.zone_code as a_code ,h.zone_name as a_name, SUM("target") as "target1" ,SUM("result") as "result1" ,SUM("target1") as "target" ,SUM("result1") as "result"  FROM chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) AND (cmastercup.hsub IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) GROUP BY h.zone_code,h.zone_name ORDER BY h.zone_code

cup.label: เครือข่ายบริการ
cup.query: SELECT m.hmain as a_code ,concat('CUP:',m.hmainname) as a_name , SUM("target") as "target1" ,SUM("result") as "result1" ,SUM("target1") as "target" ,SUM("result1") as "result"  FROM cmastercup as m LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON m.hsub=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} JOIN chospital_regis as h ON h.hoscode = m.hospcode5 LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) AND (cmastercup.hsub IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) GROUP BY m.hmain, m.hmainname ORDER BY m.hmain
